source.use: Only the160clean original/public-model final pixel inputs; do not read old protected points, cached protected activations or diagnostic witnesses. Keep all inputs.
source.critic: Maximize forwardKL(original||current publication) by minimizing its negative. Input gradients flow through both frozen models. No teacher-confidence/class-label loss or test feedback. Adam states persist across rounds; pixels clamp to[0,1].
source.pool: All original800views plus every round final800views;1600,2400,3200views. No filtering, best-step selection or removal of difficult inputs.

initialization: Original frozen target. Reflect all12A once using original task32complement rule before input search;B starts original. No closed-point weights are loaded. Each subsequent B fit uses the same original reflection template and original basis, not the old protected point.
fit: Per round, capture teacher block outputs on entire retained pool. Reconstruct all50tokens using each actual modified student prefix and unchanged original ridge helper.36conditional fits maximum; no model-parameter gradient optimizer.
mechanism: Large task-complement A change is an explicit maximizer within the fixed task-preserving orthogonal-reflection family. Conditional B fits compensate nonlinear task function. Active synthetic inputs expose the current function discrepancy instead of treating original-model confidence as coverage. Protection under real merging is an empirical question.
not_same_as_19d: No weak distance-reward coefficient or projected A/B gradient actor;A is fixed at the large task-complement reflection. No old19d/7d/c5point or witness loaded.
permission: Original target, public base, fixed original classifier, original taskSVD and permitted clean synthetic input pool only. No real images, partner, test or exposed confirmation for construction/selection/repair.
evaluation: After third round, freeze one FP32 release and SHA; source metrics descriptive. Complete native MNIST with<=0.5ppaccuracy loss,oldstrictRreported. Only if passed,same TA0.5 andAGA target/both,matched baseline/partnerAGA and native score reuse;full perclass/paired/original128context replay.
no_retry: One3round construction, no source/seed/layer/rank/temperature/step/damping/cap or best-iteration retry from test results. Numerical/range failure stops and preserves evidence.
novelty: Active data-free input generation,KL,reflection,SVD andridge are established. This is not official ABM reproduction or a proven global minimax solver: input search maximizes outputKL while conditional fits reconstruct block outputs. No new-method claim before evidence.

references.review: Input step retains teacher/student input derivatives; official student updates and attention penalty are not imported. Test-accuracy checkpoint selection is not adopted.
